svg.title: Skillforge lifecycle from contributors to tested, host-specific installations
svg.desc: Four personas contribute canonical skills, policies, verticals and agents. A five-stage quality pipeline validates the source and generated packs. One persona pack plus compatible vertical packs is then delivered to Claude Code, Codex and Kiro, while Amazon Quick receives base-pack variants through manual import.

g.text: One canonical skill library. Tested, persona-aware packs for every harness.
CONTRIBUTORS DEFINE PERSONAS AND DOMAIN INTENT
CANONICAL SKILLFORGE REPOSITORY — EDIT THIS LAYER, NOT DIST/
BUILD AND QUALITY PIPELINE — EVERY GATE RUNS, EVEN WHEN AN EARLIER ONE FAILS
Format, profile, grant, MCP, collision and built-pack contracts must all agree.
BASE PERSONA PACKS — CHOOSE EXACTLY ONE
VERTICAL ADD-ONS — CHOOSE ZERO OR MORE
Skills + persona agents, MCP and host metadata where declared
Skills-only add-ons; agents and MCP remain persona-level
RESOLVED INSTALL SET FOR CLAUDE CODE, CODEX AND KIRO
1 base + compatible add-ons · prefixed names · injected constraints · no raw profile blocks
Vertical Quick variants are not emitted today
.skillforge/install.json stores persona, verticals, paths and mode · update.sh / update.ps1 pull, rebuild, validate and replay the selection
